release_notes.en-US:
Phrase search, a memory fix, and an import fix.

Search
- Put words in quotes to find an exact phrase: "release notes" finds sessions where those words sit together in one tab title, session name or tab-group name. Before, quote marks broke search.
- A phrase never matches across two different tabs.
- Without quotes, each word can now match anywhere in the session (its name, any tab title or any group name).
- The first time you open the list after this update, TS-G may show "Optimizing your sessions…" for a few seconds while it updates its search data. This happens once.

Fixes
- Memory: favicon shrinking created throwaway image data that Firefox was slow to free, so on busy profiles the background page could grow by hundreds of MB. Fixed (thanks to kristofferR's upstream Tab Session Manager fix).
- Import: sessions exported with the internal "temp" marker were imported but never shown. They now appear.
